newsitem.title: FRANCE: Synthalabo sees 1997 profit rise over 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Synthalabo sees 1997 profit rise over 10 pct.

text.p: Pharmaceuticals company Synthelabo said on Monday that it expected sales to grow around 10 percent this year and profit to increase at a faster rate.

"Growth of consolidated sales for the six first months of 1997 should exceed 10.5 percent, or 5.5 percent on a comparable basis, in spite of weakness of the French and German markets," it said in a statement.
"For the year 1997, sales growth should be around 10 percent and net profit attributable to the group should increase at a higher rate than sales," it said.
Synthelabo, controlled by cosmetics giant L'Oreal, was set to hold its annual general meeting on Monday.
"Payment of a dividend of 5.32 French francs per share will be proposed, corresponding to total income of 7.98 French francs per share taking into account the related tax credit," it said.
